scope.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? States the population, eligibility, setting, or jurisdiction to which this policy applies. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

covered_services.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Describes covered services or substantive criteria for coverage. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

exclusions.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Describes services or circumstances not covered, including coverage limitations. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

pa_criteria.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? States substantive conditions requiring or qualifying for prior authorization or approval. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

pa_procedure.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Describes how to submit, obtain, renew, or appeal prior authorization. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

billing_workflow.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Describes billing, claims submission, coding, payment operations, or reimbursement workflow. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

boilerplate.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Contains generic administrative, legal, or repetitive policy template language rather than substantive service criteria. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

forms.instructions: Does this policy section satisfy this description? Contains a form, form instructions, or administrative documentation checklist. Assess the complete supplied section, not the question identifier. Multiple descriptions may be true.

questionType.instructions: Classify the main intent of this NC Medicaid policy question. Prefer amendment for explicit change-notice history, federal_authority for explicit federal authority, prior_authorization for prior approval, policy_variant for version comparisons, coverage for coverage or eligibility, otherwise general.

criteria.coverage: Service coverage, eligibility or substantive coverage criteria.
criteria.prior_authorization: Prior approval criteria or submission process.
criteria.federal_authority: Federal statutes or regulations and their state implementation.
criteria.policy_variant: Compare policy versions, effective periods or source variants.
